ValidationRule.description: The user tried to close Secondary Email URL task when the Secondary Email URL field is blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Complete"), ISBLANK(Secondary_Email_URL__c), ISPICKVAL(Task_Name__c, "Secondary Email URL") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't mark this Task completed until you fill in the Secondary Email URL
